item.description: Thanksgiving week is off to a messy start with weather and air travel issues impacting hundreds of flights. The FAA had to briefly shut down Delta flights to Atlanta’s Hartsfield-Jackson Airport on Sunday morning after an outage involving one of the airline’s calculation systems, coming on the heels of November’s nationwide ground stop. NBC’s Stephanie Gosk reports for TODAY.

media:content.media:title: System Outages, Weather Issues Impact Thanksgiving Travel
